This directory contains German games in Infocom Z-Machine format.

The games here can be played with an Infocom game interpreter; look in infocom/interpreters for a version for your system.

1 Subdirectory

old ◆

Older versions of some of the games in this directory.

abent.z5 ◆ [19-Apr-1998]
IFDB entry
IFWiki: Adventure

Abenteuer, a German translation of the original 350 points version of Adventure (aka Colossal Cave). Translated by Toni Arnold, based on Graham Nelson's Inform port of Adventure. Release 5 / Serial number 980419. The current version version of the game's source code and German library can be found at http://www.copyriot.com/tarnold/dinf.html

Der_kleine_Halbling.zip ◆ [22-Nov-2019]
View contents
IFDB entry

Der kleine Halbling (Z-code), ein nur-Text Remake des Grafik-Adventures für den VC-20 aus dem Jahre 1985 von Ingo Frick und Frank Gerbig. Release 14 / Serial number 181019, veröffentlicht unter GPLv3. Die Datei enthält das Spiel, eine Karte, die Lösung und den Quellcode. (Die grafische Glulx-Version befindet unter games/glulx/german/Der_kleine_Halbling.zip)
